confidence_notes: City-level price evidence is sparse and ranges vary. Restaurant, coffee, and beer estimates use Uyuni-specific 2026 ranges cross-checked with Bolivia-wide prices; cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates without live lodging research.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city used; Uyuni-specific price estimates are cross-checked against Bolivia-wide cost data, with the tourist-town context considered for sit-down meals.
